dct_creator_sm: County of Grande Prairie Open Data.
dct_description_sm: This dataset displays the Farmland Assessment Ratings by field within the County of Grande Prairie for lands that are within the Agricultural Policy Area identified in the Municipal Development Plan Bylaw #3255. This data was created in 2025 by the Planning Department and a qualified assessor. The data should be updated annually to reflect registered subdivisions and changes to the assessed field ratings.
